### Changed
- **A targeted release (`gitops.target.kubeConfig`) names its children per target and installs them into a namespace of the platform's own** (giantswarm/agent-platform#688). Each OCIRepository and HelmRelease on the installation is `<gitops.target.name>-<component>` (`gitops.target.name` is new; empty means the release name), and so is every `dependsOn` and `chartRef`. Two targeted releases in one namespace (two workload clusters of one organization) no longer collide. Each child's Helm release keeps the component's name. `gitops.targetNamespace` now defaults to `agent-platform` with the knob, and the Helm storage follows it (`storageNamespace`), so nothing lands in the organization namespace on the target any more. Without the knob, the render is unchanged. A targeted release rendered by an older chart renames its children on upgrade: Flux uninstalls the old ones from the target and installs the new ones into the new namespace.
